notes.title: Timberman VR Halloween party 🎉
notes.content:
[h1]WELCOME TO TIMBERMAN VR SCREAM FEST [/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42036506/a9d9cd6b4fe2edf0be0156454c75b2893b610efb.jpg[/img]

[h3]"pumpkins, candles, and even a cauldron
witch squirrels, a bat axe, on my shoulder a pauldron
to make the game more fun, the ghost is in the clock
Timberman VR Scream Fest is on, just knock, knock, knock"[/h3]

[h2]Hey everyone. We would like to invite you to Timberman's Halloween party. From October 25 to November 1, you'll be able to play on a special Halloween map, with lots of spooky stuff. We are curious to see who will be the leader on the board by the end of the event. [/h2]


[h2][list]
[*] 🎃🗺️new Halloween map 
[*] 👻🕰️ghost clock
[*] 🧙‍♀️🐿️witch squirrel
[*] 🦇🪓new bat axe
[*] ⚰️🤼new leaderboard
[*] 🎃🎼new music theme
[*] 🕯️🎵new sfx 
[/list][/h2]
